statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
The symptoms are non-sustained in nature.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The service addresses symptoms related to diagnoses I49.9 and R00.2.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
